title: Constructed integral and rational realization reindexing components
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible on both schemes, normalized native realizations R and S, RingReindex B, a finite coefficient field E and IntegralReindex I at E. Construct a natural isomorphism after integral localization and the inclusion of E, from common-stage pullback followed by ordinary realization R to ordinary realization S followed by derivedPull B. Any common-stage comparison whose integral components equal the constructed integral maps satisfies integralRealizationAgreement, with both literal object transports. The constructed integral isomorphism extends uniquely to the whole rational E-stage, fixing its integral components. No coefficient-enlargement square is asserted here.

theorem realizationRationalReindex_existsUnique :
    ∃! c : inclusion (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := Y) E ⋙
          commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g ⋙ ordinary l X R ≅
        inclusion (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := Y) E ⋙
          ordinary l Y S ⋙ derivedPull l X g B,
      ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y,
        c.hom.app ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
          (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) Y).obj K) =
            (realizationIntegralReindex l g R S B E I).hom.app K
